newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Perm region delays tender for lead manager.
newsitem.headline: Russian Perm region delays tender for lead manager.

text.p: Russia's Perm region, which was to organise a tender to lead manage its planned Eurobond issue this week, has postponed the tender to wait for more applications, a regional official said on Friday.
"We are postponing the tender as we are waiting for an answer from Creditanstalt-Grant," Konstantin Zakharov, aide to a deputy governor of the region, told Reuters.
He said the tender would take place as soon as the regional administration received an answer from Creditanstalt-Grant, to which it had sent an invitation three days before.
Other bidders in the tender are Russian banks AB Inkombank and OAO Bank Menatep and ING-Barings, he said.
Creditanstalt-Grant is a Russian brokerage in which Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein owns 50 percent.
Perm plans to raise between $50 and $200 million through a Eurobond issue. Inkombank and ING-Barings act as rating advisers.
